purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the existing full affiliate audit. Evidence only; this does not create a new queue task or UUID. The current main-branch COSHUMA tool dataset and latest queue state were checked first; none of these five tools currently has a dedicated application task in latest.json.

entries.commission: 30% recurring commission for 12 months for each referred paying customer
entries.payout_terms: PayPal; commission is paid on the first working day of the month after the 30-day post-transaction period, once the account has exceeded the $100 threshold and referred more than one customer
entries.eligibility: Open to affiliates globally; official page highlights AI enthusiasts, content marketers, agencies/freelancers and existing customers. Brand-keyword paid advertising and self-referrals are prohibited.
entries.evidence_summary: Rytr's current official affiliate page and current affiliate terms confirm a live signup path, 30% recurring commission for 12 months, a 60-day cookie, PayPal payouts, and a $100 payout threshold.

entries.commission: Affiliate program: 20% on the initial sale plus 20% recurring subscription commission, with performance bonuses up to 50%. A separate in-product referral program pays 40% per referred customer's purchases up to $50 per referral.
entries.payout_terms: Affiliate payouts are processed through Impact.com after validation; available methods include ACH/EFT, PayPal and wire transfer. The separate referral path is handled from the VEED account's Earn Rewards flow.
entries.eligibility: Official affiliate page says a large audience is not required and accepts creators, educators, bloggers, social marketers and affiliate specialists. The separate referral program is available to VEED account holders except Enterprise accounts; India-specific reward restrictions apply to referred customers.
entries.evidence_summary: VEED currently operates both a public Impact-based affiliate program and a separate account-based referral program. The affiliate page confirms 20% initial plus 20% recurring commission and bonus tiers up to 50%; no current cookie duration was visible on the retrieved official sources, so none is inferred.

entries.commission: Commission is paid for successful referrals that result in a sale; the current official documentation retrieved does not publish the exact percentage, so no rate is inferred.
entries.payout_terms: Affiliate onboarding supports PayPal or bank-account payout details; exact payout threshold/timing was not stated on the retrieved public documentation.
entries.eligibility: Application requires contact/company details and the channels where Gallabox marketing materials will be promoted; approval is communicated by email before dashboard access is finalized.
entries.evidence_summary: Gallabox's current official partner documentation confirms an active affiliate application path, approval flow, Tapfiliate dashboard, unique tracking link, and PayPal/bank payout setup. Exact public commission and cookie terms were not found and are left unknown.

entries.commission: Recurring commission for 12 months per active referred customer. The live partner page describes a 10% starting rate scaling up to 20%, while the current helpdesk describes higher partner tiers including 20% Premium and 30% Super Premium; the official-source discrepancy is preserved rather than guessed away.
entries.payout_terms: Commission begins accruing after the referred customer pays the first subscription invoice; refund-related commission reversals apply. Exact withdrawal threshold/timing was not visible in the retrieved live partner page snippet.
entries.eligibility: Official page presents direct affiliate registration, an exclusive referral link, commission dashboard and promotional materials; no Korea exclusion was visible in the retrieved public terms.
entries.evidence_summary: Panda Video's current official partner page confirms a live affiliate program with personalized links and 12 months of recurring commissions. Current first-party pages disagree on the exact tier ceiling, so the audit records the range/discrepancy instead of inventing a single rate.

entries.payout_terms: The affiliate dashboard tracks earnings and signups; exact public commission percentage, cookie duration, payout method and payout threshold were not visible on the retrieved current official page and remain unknown.
entries.eligibility: Official page targets blogs, newsletters and YouTube channels with job-seeker audiences. Signup creates an affiliate account, then email confirmation is required before access to the unique referral link and dashboard.
entries.evidence_summary: LoopCV's current official affiliate page confirms an active signup flow, email activation, a unique referral link and an earnings dashboard. Since the retrieved public page does not state current commission/cookie/payout figures, those values are intentionally left unknown.
